Subject: Re: Spring Gala 2027 - catering options

Dear Dr Hollis,

Thank you for inviting Saffron & Sage to put forward ideas for the School of
Engineering Spring Gala. Below is our proposal for the evening of 17 April.

What we're suggesting
We'd move away from the plated dinner of past years to a standing reception
with live stations (a hand-carved roast station, a mezze bar and a dessert
counter). For 220 guests this keeps people circulating and cuts service time.

Option A - Reception with stations ............ £42 per head
Option B - Option A plus wine pairing ........ £55 per head
Dietary meals (vegan, GF, halal) at no extra cost.

How this fits our existing agreement
Because the University already has a framework catering agreement with us,
most terms carry over. For clarity, the relevant clauses are:
  - Clause 4.2: "Final numbers must be confirmed no later than ten (10)
    working days before the event."
  - Clause 7.1: "Cancellations made within fourteen (14) days of the event
    shall be charged at 50% of the quoted price."
We'd propose relaxing 4.2 to five working days for this event, given how
late RSVPs usually come in. If that works for you, we can note it in the
booking confirmation rather than amending the agreement itself.

Happy to arrange a tasting in February. This quote is valid until 31 December.

Warm regards,
Nadia Rahman
Events Lead, Saffron & Sage Catering
07700 900 412
